title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Make sure to generate the permission set file before installing your extension
summary: Permission set files must be generated for AL extensions so non-Super users can access customized pages and reports. Without a permission set, only Super users see new objects, and production deployments will fail validation if permissions are missing.
key_points: Generate permission set files explicitly using AL commands; they do not update automatically when new objects are added
UsageCategory and ApplicationArea properties alone are insufficient; a permission set must be included with extensions
Production environments enforce permission set requirements and block extension installation if permissions are missing
Code Analysis with PerTenantExtensionCop analyzer can detect missing permission sets during development

quotes.text: If you don't include a permission set with your extension, only users with the SUPER permission set will be able to use the extension.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the root cause of why non-Super users cannot access customized features without explicit permissions

quotes.text: Please make sure that the permission file has been generated.
quotes.why_it_matters: The core directive for developers to resolve the issue of limited feature visibility

quotes.text: This file will not update automatically. If you add new objects, please update this file using the same command.
quotes.why_it_matters: Critical to understand that permission sets require manual updates when extensions are modified
